results.title: Screw Mickiewicz 3
results.overview: Dante struggles to reconcile his dreams with reality, while his relationship with Nel is tested. Then the mysterious Adam appears. In the background: the return of Korek, new feelings for Cegła, and the question of whether loyalty, friendship, and love can survive in the adult world.

results.title: Informe Plus+. Orgullo, Valor y Garra: 100 años del Real Oviedo
results.original_title: Informe Plus+. Orgullo, Valor y Garra: 100 años del Real Oviedo

results.title: 9/11: The Day the World Changed
results.original_title: 11 septembre, le jour où le monde a basculé
results.overview: This documentary retraces the attacks of September 11th, 2001 in precise chronological order—in the air, at Ground Zero, in newsrooms and in the centers of power in the USA.  Archival footage, audio recordings and findings from the 9/11 Commission Report make it possible to reconstruct the events, almost in real time.

results.title: The Company
results.overview: A precision crew assembles for one last job, but the score isn't what anyone thinks it is.

results.title: CIRCA 1919: A Hollywood Murder
results.overview: On the production of the first western epic, a story-hungry journalist gets her break when a "prop gun" kills an actor.

results.title: Buster Brooks
results.overview: Buster Brooks, a naive farm boy, moves to Hollywood with his rooster to try to make it in the movies. Ultimately, Buster has to make the difficult choice between his family life back home and his Hollywood dreams.

results.title: Submarine
results.overview: A deep-sea research submarine becomes stranded miles below the ocean surface after a mysterious systems failure. As oxygen runs low and pressure mounts, the crew battles rising panic, hidden tensions, and an unseen force outside the hull.

results.title: Bigprint
results.overview: All was quiet but a mysterious shake not only shoot the family home but also their hearts. An adventure uphold in the deep forest.

results.title: Stamptown
results.overview: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

results.title: Arctic Annihilation
results.overview: An earthquake in the Atlantic triggers a devastating drop in global temperatures, plunging the world into a deadly, apocalyptic ice age.

results.title: Fúrias
results.overview: Porto Alegre innovates once again: it is the first city entirely outsourced to a megacorporation, Fratel. The cutting-edge company's smart management brings technological solutions aimed at bringing more security and efficiency to the city, which serves as a test model for other capitals. Téia and Nanã, however, are left out of all this innovation: elderly, lesbian, and cyclists, they see their freedom and rights increasingly limited by the corporation's interventions. They are left with only two options: adapt or outsmart the system.

results.title: The Wife
results.overview: Behind a struggling filmmaker stands a wife holding a marriage on the edge of collapse. When some hidden truths surface, her quiet endurance is tested beyond its limits.

results.title: Everyone Has Something to Hide
results.overview: Kathy is shocked when she finds out her son Noah's former best friend Ethan has been murdered. She's even more shocked when her straight-A son is the prime suspect. Kathy fights to clear her son's name.

results.title: Planetenwerk
results.overview: In deserted settings between hotel, tunnel, and the restless surface of the ocean, Planetenwerk develops a play of voice, space, and perception..

results.title: METANOIA
results.overview: Drawn through dreamlike rituals and surreal spaces, a man follows a magnetic force that pulls at his fear, longing and shame – until he begins to realize that what he desires may not be dangerous, but deeply true.

results.title: Nothing Personal
results.overview: Lina, a well-known TV host, appears at Pedro’s doorstep to confront him about a cruel message he posted about her online. What begins as a showdown soon turns into an awkward living arrangement that quietly reshapes them both.

results.title: The Groove Under the Groove
results.overview: An intimate look at the life and career of Paulinho da Costa, the most recorded percussionist in music history. The documentary explores his unique rhythmic language and his collaboration with legendary icons.

results.title: Charlie Shaw's Revenge
results.overview: A group of workers preparing for the re-opening of a remote adventure park on the brink of bankruptcy, find themselves stalked by a silent killer. Cut off from any form of rescue, the survivors must band together to fight for their lives.

results.title: Mark Normand: None Too Pleased
results.overview: Mark Normand turns married life, fatherhood and hot-button topics into rapid-fire punchlines in this witty free-for-all where nothing is off limits.
